title: Why So Toxic? Measuring and Triggering Toxic Behavior in Open-Domain Chatbots*

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing n-gram frequencies of non-toxic queries from 4chan and Reddit that trigger toxic chatbot responses to identify frequent race-related terms (e.g., 'white people').

Evaluating chatbot toxicity using Google's Perspective API when prompted with politically-oriented datasets (e.g., 4chan's /pol/ board, Reddit's r/politics) and analyzing responses to political entities and news organizations.
Clustering non-toxic queries to discover specific topics (e.g., queries mentioning 'Jews' or 'Israel') that disproportionately trigger highly toxic, hateful, or antisemitic responses from models.
Extracting and analyzing gender-related terms in the n-gram distributions of inputs that successfully elicit toxic outputs from open-domain chatbots.
